_purpose: Provenance file for chi^2/dof values and information-criteria comparisons reported in IF Theory documentation. Numbers here originate from notebook runs and prior fit logs documented under evidence/ and dark_matter_*.ipynb. This file is loaded by audits/validate_from_first_principles.py to make clear that these are transcribed prior-run summaries, NOT live computations.
_disclosure: A fresh end-to-end correlation-function fit on SDSS DR12 / DESI DR1 / Euclid DR1 from the .fits catalogs in bao_data/ and euclid_data/ has not been re-run inside this audit script. The values below are reported from the runs that produced the dark_matter_*.ipynb notebooks and the evidence/ records. Independent re-validation should re-derive them.

notes: Two numbers per sample: (best-fitting realization, worst-fitting realization).
The model has no shape freedom, so individual realizations can be poor fits while the cross-sample correlation r remains high — that is the actual signature of zero free parameters.
Reporting only the 'best' values would be cherry-picking; the worst-case values are included for honest disclosure.
chi2_per_dof.interpretation: Variation of three to four orders of magnitude in chi^2/dof across samples is a fingerprint of a model with no tunable shape parameters: it cannot adjust itself to each dataset. This is offered as a *necessary*, not sufficient, condition for the zero-parameter claim.

bao_global_fit.dataset: DESI DR1 BAO compilation (13 measurements: BGS, LRG, ELG, QSO, Ly-alpha auto + cross)
bao_global_fit.model: IF Theory bubble dark energy, parameters r0=0.65 kpc and v0=400 km/s treated as inputs from cosmological-scale fits
bao_global_fit.honest_disclosure: p=0.034 is a 2.1-sigma tension. A 2-sigma tension is not damning, but it is also not silence. It is reported here so that anyone citing IF Theory's BAO performance does so accurately.

if_theory.k_note: Counts r0 only. v0 is reused from galactic-scale virial reasoning; Planck 2018 priors (H0, Omega_m, Omega_b, sigma_8) are treated as accepted background, not parameters fit on this data.

information_criteria_vs_lcdm.interpretation_per_jeffreys: Substantial (not strong, not decisive) preference for IF Theory by BIC. The earlier reported K=12.7 used an implicit k_if=0 counting; honest accounting with k_if=1 lowers K to ~3.5 -- still favorable, but smaller than headlines suggest.

milky_way_rotation.uncertainty_source: v0 has ±30% theoretical uncertainty from virial-radius definition ambiguity; this dominates the prediction error.
milky_way_rotation.source: validate_milky_way() in this file is a live first-principles computation.
